test: none: the issue is open and has no fixing PR (SolidCraft's kernel work is paused, #3992), so `pr` points at the PR that adds this fixture, as the loader requires a /pull/ URL; the issue's property test (`generic_box_cylinder_intersect`, ignored) reproduces it; the numbers here are analytic
summary: A box and a cylinder in general position (nothing coincident or tangent), found by the `identity_generic` property test, had Intersect refused on SolidCraft's kernel as 'boolean Intersect: implausible result volume 7.1625'. The box is at (11.483767761089219, 4.801612107504224, 3.6313476467611787) with size (4.789088988834864, 3.0, 10.419335961063835); the cylinder has base (29.2480632732879, 8.3683289461485, 6.947922225984966), axis +Z, radius 13.502884497756853, height 19.719218725477496. The common part is a prism of the box's rectangle clipped by the cylinder's disc, so its volume is that area times the shared height: 7.2393 mm^3 (the kernel's 7.1625 is 1 % low, which is what the result check refused). The tolerance is 0.01 mm^3, as in the other boolean cases.
